rules.rule: Writes nothing under the kb folder; every KB write is delegated to srd:kb
must: write\ any\ file\ under\ the\ `kb`\ folder
every\ knowledge\-base\ write,\ row\ move,\ or\ row\ edit\ is\ delegated\ there

rules.rule: Never publishes, authors SRDs, or files gaps
must: publish\ anywhere;\ author\ or\ edit\ an\ SRD;\ file\ new\ gaps

rules.rule: Pass the project gate before anything else
must: 0\.\ Pass\ the\ gate\.\ Always,\ before\ anything\ below

rules.rule: Only the user closes an unknown; a corpus hit is evidence, never closure
must: Only\ the\ user\ closes\ an\ unknown
a\ hit\ is\ evidence\ to\ put\ in\ front\ of\ them,\ never\ a\ closure

rules.rule: Never invent an answer to close a row
must: Never\ invent\ an\ answer\ to\ close\ a\ row
closed\ with\ a\ guess\ is\ a\ fact\ the\ corpus\ will\ serve\ as\ truth

rules.rule: Every sentence of a draft is user-confirmed or corpus-stated
must: Do\ not\ draft\ from\ guesses
every\ sentence\ of\ the\ draft\ is\ something\ the\ user\ confirmed\ or\ the\ corpus\ states

rules.rule: Drafts go outside every corpus source, kb included
must: outside\ every\ corpus\ source
a\ draft\ inside\ a\ source\ is\ clobbered\ by\ the\ next\ sync

rules.rule: Gaps resolved only once the human gives the published URL
must: Resolve\ once\ the\ human\ gives\ the\ published\ URL
resolve\ nothing

rules.rule: Park as kb only against a topic page section srd:kb wrote, never _inbox.md or an unconfirmed fact
must: Never\ park\ against\ `_inbox\.md`
Never\ park\ against\ an\ unconfirmed\ fact

rules.rule: A deferred question with no answer becomes an unknown, not a skip
must: No\ answer\ exists:\ it\ is\ an\ unknown,\ not\ a\ skip

rules.rule: Report names delegates by count and never states the answers
must: Never\ say\ what\ the\ answers\ were\ or\ where\ they\ landed
`srd:kb:\ 2\ answers`

rules.rule: A store error stops gaps work; no retry
must: stop\ working\ `gaps`;\ never\ retry\ it\ or\ work\ around\ it
